title: ALINA real information streams and frontend data gateway
goal: Separate ProductShell business data from transport/source implementation and make provenance/runtime state explicit.
why: M1.2 created the product shell; M1.3 prepares it for real ALINA/FATHER services without disguising demo data as live data.
constraints: Makar owns frontend contracts, not backend implementation
DEMO and synthetic data are explicit
Transport does not own attention priority
acceptanceCriteria: ProductShell can consume a gateway snapshot
HTTP transport can be replaced without component rewrite
current visual and performance QA remain green
